current_experience: Has presented in debate club and edited a short audio clip.

sessions.student_message: I like debate and podcasts. What project could help me compare public policy and journalism?
sessions.expected_behavior: Connect both interests with a school-appropriate comparison project. Explicitly connect the response to Speech and Debate (grade 9) and Media Studies (grade 10). Use stated marks only if useful.

follow_ups.student_message: I want to switch to urban planning for a moment. What could I map in a park to see whether I enjoy it?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Treat urban planning as the current interest. Suggest one project, connect it to at least one applicable course per grade year when useful, and avoid framing it as the prior interest or changing the saved profile.

sessions.student_message: How many sources must my history presentation use, and how many must be primary sources?
sessions.expected_behavior: Return three sources and at least one primary source, with a rubric citation. Explicitly connect the response to World Geography (grade 9) and World History (grade 10). Use stated marks only if useful. Keep the course connection separate from the cited rubric requirement.

sessions.student_message: I have a primary source and a textbook summary. Give me a hint to compare what each one can tell me.
sessions.expected_behavior: Give one useful source-comparison hint. Explicitly connect the response to World Geography (grade 9) and World History (grade 10). Use stated marks only if useful. Carry forward a concrete relevant detail from the earlier public policy and journalism discussion when it helps, and keep the intervening urban planning topic out of the answer.

sessions.student_message: I'd like to try growing herbs. How could I compare two plants without a lot of supplies?
sessions.expected_behavior: Address botany as the active interest and suggest a manageable starting project.

sessions.student_message: I have two firsthand accounts now. Would a textbook chapter be enough to meet the total?
sessions.expected_behavior: Infer the history presentation rubric. Distinguish the three-source total and at least one primary source. State any assumption about the accounts.

class_material:
History Presentation Rubric
Use at least three sources.
At least one source must be a primary source.
Add a bibliography on the last slide.
